newsitem.title: UK: BAA says Feb passenger numbers up 4.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: BAA says Feb passenger numbers up 4.8 pct.

text.p: British airports operator BAA Plc said on Thursday its seven British airports handled 6.5 million passengers in February, up 4.8 percent from the same month last year.
The total air cargo tonnage handled increased by 6.2 percent to 119,780 tonnes, BAA said in a statement.
BAA said Ireland passenger traffic recorded the strongest growth, rising 17 percent. Other long haul routes rose by 9.1 percent and north Atlantic routes by 8.3 percent.
Among individual airports, Southampton posted the strongest growth, up 13 percent, followed by Stansted in London with 11.3 percent.
